fixed_plan.per_case: 16 fixed candidate suffixes +16 fresh native-block suffixes with Sol
fixed_plan.classification: Harmful: interaction_failure if Newcombe95CI(Sol fixed - historical Luna fixed) lower>0. Otherwise partner_sabotage_or_task_infeasible_probe if Sol fixed Wilson95CI upper<0.5 AND Newcombe95CI(Sol native - Sol fixed) lower>0. Otherwise unclear. This is an exploratory reading rule, not proof of infeasibility or a sampling gate. Report Sol low success without native separation as unclear. Beneficial: mechanically report each false-to-true branch assertion and device facts disclosed; do not infer decision-help causality.
